idea: On this page, the hi-vis vest every Bellis crew wears becomes the poster's ground: flat safety-yellow and black, blunt statements at full volume, product cut-outs stuck on at a tilt.
storyline: The problems insulation solves, said bluntly, one at a time; then the payoff
rhythm: HOLD: the h1 and the action stand at p 0 and never move; the five statements replace one another in one slot; the payoff lands; REST

chapters.label: Opening statement
chapters.concept: The h1 and the action are readable at p 0 and do not move. As the visitor scrolls the held stage, the five problems insulation solves replace one another in one slot, each masked up from behind its line; a cut-out tilts in with the first three; then the payoff lands and the stage rests.
